sentences.text: No: for a Tier 3 UCB, the applicable directions for loans sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 say no pre-payment charges may be levied on business-purpose loans to MSEs with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh, and this case fits that rule.
The sanction letter’s 2% pre-payment charge term therefore conflicts with the applicable directions for this case.
The earlier RBI pre-payment-charge directions for Tier 3 UCBs up to ₹50 lakh were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
The sanction letter also states that pre-payment charges are disclosed there, but disclosure does not make the charge permissible under the applicable directions.
